description: For the actual Rogers permutation \(\pi\) of a numbering \(\psi\) with supplied compilers, \(\psi_{\pi(e)}(0)\) halts exactly when \(\varphi_e(0)\) halts, and \(\pi\) maps the standard zero-input halting set onto its \(\psi\) counterpart. Also \(\psi_{\pi(e)}(\pi(e))\) halts exactly when \(\varphi_e(\pi(e))\) halts. The same \(\pi\) maps the diagonal halting sets onto each other if and only if \(\forall e\,[\varphi_e(e)\downarrow\Longleftrightarrow\varphi_e(\pi(e))\downarrow]\).
